title: Zoe

conquest.title: Shield Strike
conquest.description: Zoe's unpredictable attacks easily enweb foes, dealing Attack*60%/66%/72%/78%/84% damage every 0.5s and amplifying damage taken by the target by 10%/15%/20%/25%/30% for 2s.

conquest.title: Agony Rush
conquest.description: Zoe requires pain to reach peak physical performance. Zoe immediately regains 20%/25%/30%/35%/40% of max Health under 50% Health. Can only activate once per battle.

conquest.title: Holy Might
conquest.description: Zoe inspires her fellow warriors to battle, boosting your heroes' Attack Speed by 3%/4%/5%/6%/7%.

expedition.title: Sundering Wound
expedition.description: Your Squads' Attacks gain a 20% chance of inflicting Sunder, dealing 8%/16%/24%/32%/40% damage per turn for 3 turns.

expedition.title: Stoic
expedition.description: Zoe is a gifted female orator, and her rousing battle speeches increase the total Squads' Attack by 5%/10%/15%/20%/25%

expedition.title: Infinite Arsenal
expedition.description: Zoe strikes the enemy so completely and utterly that your Squads' Attacks gain a 50% chance of amplifying enemy squads' damage taken by 10%/20%/30%/40%/50%.

skills.title: Death Or Glory
skills.description: Zoe's inner demon is awakened only by pain. Gaining 8%/12%/16%/20%/24% increased Attack until the end of battle once " Agony Rush" is triggered.

skills.title: Dark Lady
skills.description: Zoe is a relentlessly demanding garrison commander, increasing Defender Squads' Attack by 5%/7.5%/10%/12.5%/15%.

story: Zoe manifests her emotional states not through words or actions, but through her magical hair... According to Amadeus, her hair has reflected her mood since she was young.

While black signifies her patience as she waits to strike at her prey, yellow reflects her exhilaration as she starts hunting. Zoe channels the energy of every cell in her body to chase down her prey, ultimately tearing them apart.

Zoe isn't a noble knight or an elegant archer, but an adopted child of the Unjust League just like Amadeus. Born with immense strength, Zoe always charges to the frontline of battles, relishing the exhilaration each wound brings and taking pleasure in raw, physical contact.
Ruthless in her attacks, Zoe is willing to go to any lengths to secure victory, even if it means being seen as a villain.
To her, winning is everything, and honor holds little value.
Zoe was raised in a suburban area north of Noxholm, a region bordering a forest and home to the destitute.

Yet, even there, Zoe wasn't spared from the exorbitant taxes, the nobles who tormented the common folk for amusement, and the fanatical cults eager to spread their influence. She also witnessed countless betrayals and backstabbing, even within families. The underprivileged, regarded as insignificant by the nobility, were willing to pay any price just to survive another day.

It was in this harsh reality that Zoe realized the necessity of becoming stronger—so she could call the shots in this unforgiving society and one day obliterate everything that stood against her beliefs.

Zoe is infamous for getting into bar brawls, being one of the top troublemakers at the Adventurers' Camp, and using underhanded tactics to snatch bounty Missions. She's become the town's bogeyman—mothers often use her name to scare unruly children into behaving.

But despite her rough reputation, Zoe has earned a great deal of respect and admiration. She's won "Best Vanguard Captain" and "Best Adventure Com Panion" multiple times at the camp, and she's even the female lead in a Romance novel written by bestselling author Smith. In his book, Fluttering Heart, there's a line that says, "The lady is like a rainbow—you only believe such beauty exists when you see it." It’s a sentiment that captures how those who admire Zoe truly feel.
